Summary: Checks that Microsoft Entra users have the attributes HR, dynamic groups and licensing depend on, that phones, countries and names are formatted consistently, and that departments, titles and addresses use your approved values and office locations. Read-only.

Prerequisites.Text: An account or app that can read users and group members in Microsoft Graph (User.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All; Directory.Read.All covers both).

Steps.Text: To include employee hire dates (MP.CLT.UA.1006), connect with the extra scope instead. Without it, that test reports Investigate.

Notes: Connect-Maester does not ask for User-LifeCycleInfo.Read.All. Every other test works with the scopes it asks for.

Commands.Text: Maester's own tests and this pack
Leave out the fields many organisations don't use (business phone, mobile, fax, office location)
List every failing user for one test instead of the first 100

Notes: Pack-wide settings go under GlobalSettings in maester-config.json, for example "CLT.UA.ExcludedUsers": ["svc-scanner@contoso.com"]. Per-test settings go under TestSettings, for example { "Id": "MP.CLT.UA.1005", "Parameters": { "ExcludedGroups": ["<group id>"] } }.

Options.Name: GlobalSettings: CLT.UA.ExcludedUsers
Options.Text: Users (UPN or object ID) to leave out of every test in the pack, such as service accounts.

Options.Name: GlobalSettings: CLT.UA.ExcludedGroups
Options.Text: Groups (object ID or mail address) whose members, including nested members, are left out of every test.

Options.Name: GlobalSettings: CLT.UA.ExcludeEmergencyAccessAccounts
Options.Text: Leave out Maester's EmergencyAccessAccounts (break-glass users and groups) in every test.

Options.Name: GlobalSettings: CLT.UA.OnlyLicensedUsers
Options.Text: Check only member users with a licence. Guests are not affected.

Options.Name: ExcludedUsers, ExcludedGroups (every test)
Options.Text: More users (UPN or object ID) or groups (object ID) to leave out of one test. They add to the pack-wide and emergency access exclusions.

Options.Name: GlobalSettings: CLT.UA.AllowedValues
Options.Text: Approved values by Graph property (department, jobTitle, city, ...) and office locations, for MP.CLT.UA.1013 and 1018-1026.

Options.Name: GlobalSettings: CLT.UA.AllowedValuesFile
Options.Text: A JSON file of more approved values, in the same shape or the 2.x validation.json shape. Relative to the folder the run starts in.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1018-1025 AllowedValues
Options.Text: Approved values for one test; replaces the shared CLT.UA.AllowedValues for that test.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1026 Fields
Options.Default: street, city, state, postal code, country, company
Options.Text: Address fields that must match one approved location. Add businessPhones or officeLocation to compare them too.

Options.Name: MaxRows (every test)
Options.Text: Most users or rows listed in a result. 0 lists them all.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1002 ExcludedJobTitles
Options.Text: Job titles at the top of the organisation, which have no manager.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1008 Fields
Options.Text: Address fields that must be set. officeLocation can be added.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1010 IgnoreLeadingZeros
Options.Text: Treat employee IDs that differ only in leading zeros as the same ID.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1011 AllowSpaces
Options.Text: Allow spaces inside phone numbers, such as +1 425 555 0100.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1011 PhonePattern
Options.Text: Regular expression a phone number must match (E.164 by default).

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1013 AllowedCountries
Options.Text: The exact country spellings your organisation uses, such as United States.

AppOnly.Text: Give the app the application permissions User.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All, and User-LifeCycleInfo.Read.All for hire dates. The pack only reads.
